query: Which staggered-event estimator (Sun & Abraham or Callaway & Sant’Anna) best fits our FTA and COVID timing, and what pre-trend/placebo diagnostics and power thresholds will we pre-register?

response.query: Which staggered-event estimator (Sun & Abraham or Callaway & Sant’Anna) best fits our FTA and COVID timing, and what pre-trend/placebo diagnostics and power thresholds will we pre-register?
response.answer: The Callaway & Sant’Anna estimator best fits FTA and COVID timing. Pre-register pre-trend diagnostics and placebo tests. Use power thresholds based on sample size and effect size.
